'''Darth Kinsho''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] at the start of the [[Third Galactic War|new conflict]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He participated in the [[Invasion of Ossus]], attacking the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] in search of the Grand Holocron.<ref name="Expel" />
